# Propria design-contract changelog

> _Byline: Codex · GPT-5 · 2026-09-12._

## 1.0.0 — 2026-09-12

- Accepted Carbon-Linen-Seal as the initial, centrally adjustable palette direction.
- Preserved Probata's approved Evidence Operations Desk and Modular Service Cockpit as the General
  and Advanced structural donors.
- Added independent light/dark theme and General/Advanced experience axes.
- Added framework-neutral foundations and adapters for Intake, Probata, advocatio and the portal.
- Made `tokens.json` the single editable source and added deterministic CSS generation/drift checks.
- Added exact package, token, density, adapter, contrast and CSS-policy verification.

## 0.9.0 — 2026-09-12

- Proposed the first portable semantic token contract for visual review.
